provenance: Original authored geometry and materials for Let me sleep. User reference images guide shapes only; no external textures.

facial_contract.blink_interpolation: Piecewise adjacent samples at closure0/.25/.50/.75/1; two neighboring morph weights sum to100. Basis needs no weight. This keeps lid paths outside the globe.
facial_contract.writer: One Presentation facial controller after animation, shared with gameplay
facial_contract.tracking: Live target, smoothed/clamped offset from this frame animated base; never accumulate last frame offset
facial_contract.legacy_blink_clip: Eye local scale Z is a legacy signal only; read before resetting scale to1, map (1-z)/.93 to lid closure
facial_contract.scope: Same rig names/hierarchy; v0.3.0 sketch face: large protruding eyes centred at Socket.Eye height 1.53; head/cap/skin material customization retained

contact.surface_rotation_contract: local +Y outward normal, forward projected tangent; runtime validation belongs to Gameplay/Presentation

shell_tones.shade_rule: faces on Mosquito_Shell whose normal z < -0.30 use Mosquito_ShellShade
shell_tones.unity_note: per-face materials, no vertex colour; the runtime Mosquito colour binding covers Mosquito_Shell/Mosquito_Abdomen only, so tinting must also scale Mosquito_ShellShade/ShellDark/ShellDeep to keep a recoloured body faceted

contact.wing_vein_unity_note: Mosquito_WingVein/Mosquito_WingEdge carry alpha .35; CharacterContentBuilder renders every wing material transparent with its authored alpha (membrane first, veins and edge sorted after it) and rejects opaque wing materials
contact.leg_skin_note: leg bones are the unchanged R4 bind; the visible knee/foot (A stance) are skin only: tibia skin blends femur -> tarsus, foot rigid on the tarsus

face.source_coordinates: metres, Z up, -Y forward; actor scale .5 once

gaze.order: Rz(yaw) @ Rx(pitch) applied to bind around each eye center

face.eye_housing: fixed rear cup weighted to Head: recessed .8 mm copy of each open shutter; covers the posterior white during closure
face.eye_collar: fixed red rim faces weighted to Head (EyeCollar.L/R lateral, EyeCollarInner.L/R medial) 0.6 deg behind the shutters rest-edge surface, from the white to 98.5% of the housing inner shell, behind the housing front chamfer; never touched by the shutters
face.eye_cap: fixed eyelid wedge weighted to Head (EyeCap.L/R) from the top of the white (~12% of its front-view height) up under the upper shutter rim; inside the innermost shell
face.rest_pose: upper shutter rests at ~66 deg over the eyelid cap, lower at ~-104 deg behind the bottom of the white; blink closure 0..1 starts from that bind pose
face.runtime_writer: one shared facial driver after Animator/Playable evaluation; menu supplies target only
face.runtime_binding: serialize axes transformed into each imported bone bind-local frame; do not assume FBX local XYZ
face.body_clips: 15 existing IDs unchanged; all facial tracks neutral, runtime overwrites six facial controls only
face.customization: MosquitoSkin renderer; existing Mosquito_Shell color binding. EyeWhite/Expression remain unchanged.
face.native_status: source candidate only; geometry, FBX axes, closure and runtime visibility await Director slot

contact.art_acceptance: pending real render, complete clips, Unity and independent review

surface_walk.support_center: each coxa Y; tarsal bind X/Z retained
surface_walk.phase_direction: positive phase moves supported feet along source +Y; actor forward is source -Y
surface_walk.phase_formula: frac(authorityMotionPhase * (0.3 / distance_per_cycle_unity_m)); convert before modulo, once
surface_walk.range_status: analytic source contract; readable cadence/contact requires native review

flight.wing_source_axes: mirror around each bind origin: Rz(sign*fold) @ Ry(-sign*flap)
flight.acceptance: candidate source only; normal-speed final-scale wings/body/legs and blends pending

contact.bite_tip_policy: Head/Thorax/Proboscis bind transforms retained throughout BiteStart/BiteLoop/Bite
contact.fall_contact_policy: evaluated mesh minimum at authored support plane; native landing/transition review pending

review_status: New selected-species source; motion, renders and Unity import pending
